rows.verified: Engineering controls and safe systems of work should be applied before relying on PPE for residual risk.
PPE may be needed where falling materials could strike people.
PPE selection must follow a risk assessment rather than a generic equipment list.
The HSE PPE guidance separately addresses selection, use, maintenance and product safety.
PPE performance depends on correct selection, compatibility, fit, condition, maintenance, training, supervision and consistent use.
HSE PPE guidance is hazard-, equipment-, wearer-, task-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level protection probability.
UKHSA national guidance covers management of suspected measles cases.
The guidance identifies patient details that should be collected for suspected cases.
The guidance covers who should be notified when measles is suspected.
The guidance covers assessment of the risk of spread among close contacts.
The national measles guidelines were last updated on 2 April 2026.
The publication includes a national guideline document and a warn-and-inform letter.
The principal guideline document is a 62-page UKHSA publication.
The guidance is intended for case and contact management rather than population-level parcel scoring.
Measles transmission risk depends on infectious period, proximity, duration, ventilation, immunity, vaccination, age and response timing.
UKHSA case-management guidance is case-, contact-, setting-, immunity-, intervention- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
The UKHSA dashboard describes measles as a viral infectious disease.
The dashboard reports laboratory-confirmed measles cases in England.
The dashboard states that measles data are normally updated every other Thursday at 09:30.
When a bank holiday falls on Monday or Tuesday, the update is scheduled for Friday at 09:30.
The 23 July 2026 snapshot reported 933 laboratory-confirmed cases in England since January 2026.
The same snapshot reported 99 cases in the preceding four weeks.
All English regions had reported at least one confirmed case with symptom onset since January 2026.
The dashboard provides regional and age-group breakdowns rather than parcel-level exposure measurements.
Surveillance counts are affected by case definitions, testing, reporting delays, geography, age structure, immunity and publication date.
UKHSA dashboard data are population surveillance snapshots and must not be treated as exact parcel-level infection probability.
